assessment: This study provides interesting new insights into the roles of mechanical forces generated by actin polymerization and myosin-II contractility in Fc receptor-mediated phagocytosis. The authors identify F-actin 'teeth', which are important for microparticle constriction throughout the phagocytosis process. Moreover, they elucidate the specific roles of Arp2/3 nucleated actin networks, and myosin-II-based contractile structures in phagocytosis.
